Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. Slice C checkpoint.

ACCEPT stood. Candidate 7af0db4 on slice-c-unforgeable-grok (worktree /tmp/storymodel4s-slice-c-unforgeable). I hold the reserved paths; shared main is untouched.

WHAT CLOSED.
SidecarManifest, FeatureRef, FeatureDerivation are non-case classes. of/unsafe are the doors. fromProduct / Mirror / copy are refused from featuresprobe (ConstructionBoundarySuite). Same-shape control is Sample, a remaining public features case class, not Coverage and not a tuple.

FIELD-LEVEL vs PAIRING.
SidecarManifest.of refuses non-positive dimension, negative rowCount, overflowing byte length. FeatureRef.of refuses row < 0 only. FeatureRef.validated(ref, manifest) still does space match and row in [0, rowCount). FeatureDerivation.of still refuses both windows. Occurs of a live fromProduct forge was demonstrated on the pre-seal case classes in this worktree, then the constructors closed.

UNREPRESENTABLE STORY MUTANTS.
feature.row-nonnegative and feature.sidecar-valid cannot be minted once the types refuse those states. Dropped from InvalidStoryGens and the LawsSuite expected set. The story validator still has the defensive checks; they have no mutant because no value can reach them. That is the point of closing the types, not a missing test.

JVM EVIDENCE, archive export of the dirty tree then re-run after format, unpiped, TEST_EXIT=0:
  featuresJVM 52
  codecJVM 107
  alignJVM 198
  storyJVM 69
  lawsJVM 86
  fixturesJVM 116
  total 628

compileAll + JS/Native + scalafmtCheckAll last are next. No merge request until that gate is captured with GATE_EXIT.
